attributes.name: torso_bends_forward
attributes.text: The torso bends forward from the hips.
attributes.definition: The upper spine and neck move forward and down in front of the hips, clearly more than a slight lean.

attributes.name: deep_knee_hip_bend
attributes.text: Both knees and hips bend deeply, lowering the hips.
attributes.definition: The hip joints drop well below standing height because both knees and hips flex, as in a squat, crouch, or sitting.

attributes.name: seated_posture
attributes.text: The person is seated with hips low and knees bent.
attributes.definition: For most of the action the hips are at seat height with thighs roughly horizontal, and the legs do not move much.

attributes.name: head_tilted_down
attributes.text: The head is tilted down toward the hands or floor.
attributes.definition: The head joint is lowered forward relative to the neck and stays that way for much of the action.

attributes.name: head_tilted_back
attributes.text: The head tilts backward, face turning up.
attributes.definition: The head joint moves back relative to the neck so the face points upward, during part of the action.

attributes.name: torso_leans_back
attributes.definition: The shoulders move behind the hips so the spine tilts back, at least briefly.

attributes.name: elbow_raised_to_side
attributes.text: The elbow is raised out to the side near shoulder height.
attributes.definition: The elbow joint moves away from the torso sideways and up, roughly to shoulder level, while the hand is near the head or face.

attributes.name: arms_raised_overhead
attributes.text: Both arms are raised with hands at or above head height.
attributes.definition: Both hand joints are at or above the head for part of the action.

attributes.name: shoulders_hunched
attributes.text: The shoulders round inward and the upper body curls.
attributes.definition: The shoulder joints come forward and inward toward the chest, with the head often dropping.

attributes.name: torso_twisted
attributes.text: The shoulders turn relative to the hips.
attributes.definition: The line between the shoulders rotates away from the line between the hips at some point in the action.

attributes.name: torso_tilts_sideways
attributes.text: The upper body leans to one side.
attributes.definition: The spine tilts left or right so one shoulder is clearly lower than the other.

attributes.name: single_leg_stance
attributes.text: The body stands on one leg while the other foot is off the floor.
attributes.definition: For part of the action only one foot supports the body while the other is lifted, not as part of normal walking.

attributes.name: forearms_horizontal_at_chest
attributes.text: A forearm is held horizontal across the front of the chest.
attributes.definition: One or both forearms lie roughly level in front of the chest, crossing toward the opposite side.

attributes.name: body_ends_low
attributes.text: The body ends lowered near the floor and stays down.
attributes.definition: At the end of the action the hips and torso are much lower than standing and remain there.
